sentences.text: The case of the present applicant stands on better footing to that of co-accused persons.
He is ready to face the trial, therefore, requested for anticipatory bail during pendency of trial.
Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and the perusal of record and the fact that co-accused persons have already been granted anticipatory bail and the case of the present applicant is on better footing, there appears ground to grant anticipatory bail in favour of applicant during pendency of trial.

The applicantRam Gopal @ Kaka shall be released on anticipatory bail during pendency of trial on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the learned trial court unless exempted;

( ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;

(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport, the same shall be deposited by him before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
In default of any of the conditions, this bail order shall stand automatically vacated.

Order Date :- 18.12.2023 A. Singh  Ram Gopal @ Kaka vs State Of U.P. on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19389445/
